query.en: Create a 20-second launch film for Driftnote, a fictional app that turns messy meeting audio into a one-page summary. Show the core transformation: scattered speech bubbles and transcript fragments condense, line by line, into a tidy summary card with three action items. Brand line: "Meetings in. Decisions out." Invent only simple UI for this film — no metrics, customers or pricing. Deep navy canvas, warm white type, one coral accent. Close on the Driftnote wordmark and the brand line, held for two seconds.
query.zh-CN: 为虚构的 App「Driftnote」制作一段 20 秒的产品发布短片。它能把杂乱的会议录音整理成一页纸总结。展示核心变化：散落的对话气泡和转写片段逐行收拢，变成一张整洁的总结卡片，上面有三条待办事项。品牌口号：“会议进来，决定出去。”界面只为这支短片简单设计，不要编造数据、客户或价格。深海军蓝背景、暖白色文字、一种珊瑚色强调色。结尾停在 Driftnote 字标和口号上，保持两秒。
